title: Gupta administration: more terms and detail

boxes.title: Officials, law & units: more
items: Samudragupta reinstated some samantas; **Harisena** inherited his post
**Kumaramatya**: ranked with princes; own office (**adhikarana**); often paid in **cash**
Criminal: theft, adultery; civil: property; laws followed **varna** hierarchy
Bhukti also = desha / rashtra; **Uparika** appointed by king, sometimes "Maharaja"
Village headman's ==consent needed== for land deals

boxes.title: Tax points
items: Vishti: unpaid, for army, officials, donee; Junagadh + copper inscriptions
Bhoga: fruits, firewood, flowers; Uparikara probably on **temporary tenants**
